_doc: LR-166: peoples, cultures and belts of the mythic world.
species.hellene.name: Hellene
species.hellene.desc: Hellenes of the Middle Sea: seafarers, debaters of the agora and athletes. A touch more charming and learned than other folk, they suffer the cold worse. Hospitality is law to them.
species.northman.name: Northman
species.northman.desc: Northmen of the fjords: longhouses, runes, sagas and the thing. Stronger and hardier, careless of the cold, less of the charm.
species.woodfolk.name: woodfolk
species.woodfolk.desc: Folk of the Middle Woods, Slavs and Celts: they know the thicket, herbs and bees best of all, are superstitious and keep to their kin.
species.steppe_folk.name: steppe dweller
species.steppe_folk.desc: People of the Eastern Steppe, Scythians and Turks: camps, kurgans, the bow and the yurt. Fine archers, hardy and keen-eyed.
species.nilote.name: Nile dweller
species.nilote.desc: People of the Nile valley: scribes, priests and tomb builders, fed by the flood. Learned and devout, they dislike the cold.
species.centaur.name: centaur
species.centaur.desc: Mountain centaurs of the Middle Sea: tutors, healers and archers, wild in their cups. On four legs they cannot climb a ladder or board a boat.
species.steppe_centaur.name: steppe centaur
species.steppe_centaur.desc: Steppe centaurs: the swiftest horse-archers of the camps, allies of the orc riders.
species.minotaur.name: minotaur
species.minotaur.desc: Minotaurs of the Labyrinth isle: horned strongmen and maze builders. Terrible in a fight, unkind to strangers.
species.cyclops.name: cyclops
species.cyclops.desc: Cyclopes of the volcanic isles: one-eyed giant smiths and wall builders. They see worse than others and forge better than all.
species.satyr.name: satyr
species.satyr.desc: Satyrs of the vineyards and woods: goat-legged musicians and revellers. Men only; their daughters are born to their mother's people.
species.nymph.name: nymph
species.nymph.desc: Nymphs of springs, groves and bays: they live for ages and keep to their place. Women only; their sons are born to their father's people.
species.vila.name: vila
species.vila.desc: Vilas of forest glades and cloud mountains: warrior maidens of wind and water. Women only; their sons are born to their father's people.
species.alv.name: alf
species.alv.desc: Alfar of the North, light elves of the auroras: light, frost and runes. The polar night and its trolls are their foes.
culture.polis_hellene.name: Hellenic polis
culture.polis_hellene.desc: The Hellenic poleis: agora, symposium and games, a council of elders. Xenia, the law of hospitality, is sacred: even gods punish those who wrong a guest.
culture.isle_sailor.name: island seafarers
culture.isle_sailor.desc: Islanders of the Middle Sea: trade, piracy and the long road home. Freer than the polis and closer to the sea.
culture.pastoral_hills.name: hill shepherds
culture.pastoral_hills.desc: Shepherds of Arcadia and Pelion: men and mountain centaurs share one village, and centaurs teach the children hunting and herbs.
culture.labyrinth.name: the Labyrinth
culture.labyrinth.desc: Minotaurs of the Labyrinth isle: a city of passages and walls, bull leaping and blood feud. Hard to enter, harder still to leave.
culture.grove_nymph.name: grove nymphs
culture.grove_nymph.desc: Nymphs of groves and springs, and satyrs with them. To fell their grove or foul their water is a crime. Their unions are free, between consenting adults.
culture.satyr_vine.name: satyrs of the vine
culture.satyr_vine.desc: Satyrs of the vineyards with their nymphs: music, wine and the vintage feast. They love a guest and hate order.
culture.smith_cyclops.name: cyclops forges
culture.smith_cyclops.desc: Cyclopes of the volcanic isles: forges inside fiery mountains and walls of boulders. The law of hospitality is a trial for them.
culture.port_kobal.name: port kobaloi
culture.port_kobal.desc: Kobaloi of the southern ports: hagglers, pranksters and dockside thieves. They live among Hellenes too, and theft is cleverness to them.
culture.nile_priest.name: priests of the Nile
culture.nile_priest.desc: People of the Nile: scribes, priests and tomb builders. The cult of the dead, writing and the flood; robbing a tomb is a dreadful crime.
culture.forest_elf.name: forest sidhe
culture.forest_elf.desc: The sidhe of the hills of the Middle Woods: long-lived, close to life and light, they abide no iron in their groves. Their hills are gates to the Underworld.
culture.vila_glade.name: glade vilas
culture.vila_glade.desc: Vilas of the forest glades: they dance the kolo, keep the waters and winds and avenge oath-breakers. Their husbands and sons of the woodfolk live with them.
culture.celtic_grove.name: Celtic clans
culture.celtic_grove.desc: Celtic clans of the Middle Woods: druids and bards, geasa, barrows and the hills of the sidhe nearby.
culture.slav_village.name: Slavic village
culture.slav_village.desc: Slavic villages of the Middle Woods: the hut and its domovoi, the elders' veche, matchmakers and Kupala night, the leshy beyond the fence.
culture.north_folk.name: fjord folk
culture.north_folk.desc: Northmen: longhouses, the thing, sagas and runes, raids by ship. Oaths and blood feud; the dead go to a burning ship.
culture.dwarf_hold.name: mountain hold
culture.dwarf_hold.desc: Mountain holds of the northern dwarves: forges where the treasures of the gods are made, oaths on stone and the memory of ancestors.
culture.alv_hall.name: alf halls
culture.alv_hall.desc: Alfar of the auroras: bright halls, runes and songs. The dark of the polar night and the trolls are their foes.
culture.jotun_hold.name: jotnar
culture.jotun_hold.desc: Jotnar of the ice mountains, giant rivals of the gods: raids, feasts and cunning against runes and hammer.
culture.troll_fell.name: fell trolls
culture.troll_fell.desc: Trolls of the northern fells: they turn to stone in the sun and sleep through the polar summer; in the polar night they are deadly.
culture.steppe_clan.name: steppe clans
culture.steppe_clan.desc: People of the steppe: camps and yurts, ancestors' kurgans, the kurultai of clans. A guest in the yurt is sacred; horse theft is the worst crime.
culture.steppe_rider.name: rider horde
culture.steppe_rider.desc: Orc riders of the Eastern Steppe allied with the steppe centaurs: the horde, the kurultai and the raid under the Eternal Sky.
culture.draconic.desc: Dragons of the northern peaks and serpents of the steppe: the lair, the hoard and the tribute.
world.belt.mediterranean.name: the Middle Sea
world.belt.mediterranean.desc: The warm south of isles and olives: Hellenic poleis, mountain centaurs, nymphs and satyrs, minotaurs of the Labyrinth and cyclopes of the volcanoes.
world.belt.forest.name: the Middle Woods
world.belt.forest.desc: Thickets, marshes and rivers between south and north: Slavic villages and Celtic clans, the sidhe of the hills, vilas of the glades.
world.belt.north.name: the North
world.belt.north.desc: Mountains, fjords and the polar night: Northmen, dwarves under the mountain, alfar of the auroras, jotnar, trolls and the dragons of the peaks.
world.belt.steppe.name: the Eastern Steppe
world.belt.steppe.desc: Dry steppe and kurgans: nomad clans of men, orc riders and steppe centaurs under the Eternal Sky.
world.belt.nile.name: the Nile valley
world.belt.nile.desc: A river in the desert: priests, scribes and tombs (second wave: for now only the people of the Nile).
culture.trad.xenia.name: Xenia
culture.trad.xenia.desc: The law of hospitality: take in, feed and never harm a guest.
culture.trad.symposium.name: Symposium
culture.trad.symposium.desc: Talk, songs and stories over a shared cup.
culture.trad.agon_games.name: Games
culture.trad.agon_games.desc: Running, wrestling and games for honour.
culture.trad.bull_leaping.name: Bull leaping
culture.trad.bull_leaping.desc: Leaping over the bull: the daring and skill of the young.
culture.trad.spring_offerings.name: Gifts to the spring
culture.trad.spring_offerings.desc: Prayers and gifts to the water and tree of the place.
culture.trad.wine_feast.name: Vintage feast
culture.trad.wine_feast.desc: Dances, songs and the wine of the vintage.
culture.trad.forge_vigil.name: Forge vigil
culture.trad.forge_vigil.desc: Work at the fire as worship: the first forging and a vow to the forge.
culture.trad.haggling.name: Haggling
culture.trad.haggling.desc: Arguing the price as an art and a pleasure.
culture.trad.druid_council.name: Druid council
culture.trad.druid_council.desc: Druids judge, read omens and lead the rites.
culture.trad.kupala_night.name: Kupala night
culture.trad.kupala_night.desc: Bonfires, round dances and songs on the shortest night.
culture.trad.thing_assembly.name: The thing
culture.trad.thing_assembly.desc: The assembly of the free: judgement, oaths and choosing heirs.
culture.trad.rune_lore.name: Rune lore
culture.trad.rune_lore.desc: Runes, divination and tales of the old days.
culture.trad.kurultai.name: Kurultai
culture.trad.kurultai.desc: The gathering of clans: judgement, oaths and choosing a chief.
